title: Span-program-based quantum algorithm for evaluating formulas
supports: Span-program definition, formula composition, graph spectral mechanism, and balanced AND-OR/NAND classical versus quantum query comparisons.
note: Read the introduction and Sections 2.1–2.4, including the span definition and target/eigenvector correspondence. The lesson uses an original finite four-input instance and does not assert that its 84-query circuit realizes the asymptotic theorem.

title: Reflections for quantum query algorithms
supports: Fixed kernel reflection, input-dependent reflection, zero-phase detection, spectral completeness/soundness mechanism, and query-versus-gate-cost distinction.
note: Read Section 2 algorithms and relevant Section 3 spectral analysis. The lesson reverses reflection order (taking the inverse), uses its own target scale, and establishes finite error by exact rational enumeration of all 16 inputs.
